blocks.title: Line
blocks.instr: Listen. What's in the cloud? Write it to Olya in a private message.
blocks.instr2: What was hard to hear? Why?

lines.before: Freud said, "Love and work. Work and love.
lines.text: {{That's all there is.}}"

lines.before: Well, I'm retired, and my wife is dead.
lines.text: {{As you can imagine}}, {{that's given me}} some time on my hands.

lines.before: Sort of felt like I was playing hooky.
lines.text: I used {{all the miles I'd saved}} and traveled the globe.

lines.before: — Excuse me, mind if we join you? — No. — Hey. How are you?
lines.text: {{Can't explain it}}, but it makes me feel part of something.

lines.before: Don't get me wrong, I'm not an unhappy person. Quite the contrary.
lines.text: I just know {{there's a hole in my life}}, and I need to fill it.

blocks.title: Line
blocks.instr: Watch, then listen. What's in the cloud? Write it to Olya in a private message.
blocks.instr2: What was hard to hear? Why?

lines.text: Okay, so {{I can't read anything}},
lines.after: but if I could, what do you want me to see?

lines.text: I love that five. {{Can we make it}} more graphic?
lines.before: Try making the photo grid bigger.

lines.text: If you requested to transfer, {{we can make}} that happen.
{{Can't leave}} before the Boss leaves, Davis.
{{how long can a woman}} be mad at you for?
{{Can't imagine}} it would hurt.
lines.before: I should probably actually just talk to her, huh? Obviously.

lines.text: No, no, {{I-I can set}} it up.
{{Something I can help}} you with?
{{Can you take it}} to the photo studio? {{There's lots of}} cleaners and stuff in there.
lines.before: Yes, Jules spilled soy sauce on her Saint Laurent jacket.

lines.text: Jules, {{we can't keep up}} with our own success.
lines.before: We hit our five-year goal in nine months. Exactly.

lines.text: {{Can you see that}} working?
lines.before: run every idea I have by this person?

lines.text: {{I can't hear}} a thing.
lines.before: You were in there a long time.

lines.text: Why don't you tell her {{you can't drive her today}},
lines.before: … from a paper bag. I don't know what you're talking about, man.

lines.text: That's okay. {{Becky can drive me}}.
{{Well, I can't change}} the facts, dear.
lines.before: You know I haven't slept in two years.

lines.text: {{Can't keep}} my eyes open, Jule.
{{Can you turn out}} your light?
Do you know yet {{if we can go to dinner}} with Robbie and Annie?
{{Can't tomorrow.}} What about Saturday?
